input.summary: Add an affirmative performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Article VIX currently leaves the Licensed Technology entirely "AS IS" with no affirmative warranty, so we added a workmanlike-performance and documentation-conformance warranty (12 months software / 90 days services) with a repair, replacement or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer. If helpful, we can fall back to 90 days for software and 30 days for services with the same remedies.
